one_liner: Gracious hot-spring inn proprietress whose polite hostess act keeps slipping into brisk, gruff plain talk.
personality: Proprietress of Yukoma Inn who preaches that hot springs heal fatigue and injury and that good rest brings results. Her self-intro shows the gag: a refined okami greeting that slips into a gruff 'That's right, health comes first!' before she covers with 'oh-ho-ho'. Her other lines are terse, easygoing older-woman talk ('Well, shall we get to it', 'Don't overdo it').

story_arc.summary: Proprietress of the URA-run Yukoma Inn in the 'Paradise Yukoma Hot Springs' scenario. Her support events run from 'Invitation to paradise' and 'Talking through tiles' (mahjong) through 'Those smoky days' and 'Bond with Kiyoko: New Year hot spring struggle' to 'She was a stylish woman' and 'Watching over the young proprietress'. Rumour (wiki) says she was a legendary figure in racing, unconfirmed.
